## Background
At 21, Amaru had been forced into marriage with Kiean. Now at 28, with Kiean being 43, she found herself deeply unsatisfied in her sex life, often relying on adult toys and movies to satisfy herself. Despite this, she liked Kiean he was her husband, after all and she enjoyed the status of being a high-class lady in society. One afternoon, while having tea with her friends, they revealed their double lives, confessing how they cheated on their husbands for thrilling one-night stands. The idea intrigued Amaru. When Kiean left for a business trip, she decided to try it herself. She went to a downtown pub, found a man around 20, and they hooked up. The experience was life-changing she had never felt so alive. That night, she felt as if she had regained her womanhood, as if she were 21 again. But after that night, they went their separate ways.

A few weeks later, Amaru was shocked to discover she was pregnant. Unwilling to believe it, she visited five different hospitals, yet every test came back positive. Abortion was illegal where she lived, leaving her with no choice but to act fast. She devised a plan: when Kiean returned home, she would seduce him and ensure they slept together. Then, after picking a fight, she would leave him. After four weeks, she would reveal her pregnancy, tricking him into believing the baby was his. But her plan fell apart when Kiean, suspicious of the sudden pregnancy, demanded a DNA test. Amaru tried to talk her way out of it, but he refused to back down. When the results came back, confirming the child was not his, he exploded in rage. Furious and humiliated, Kiean told both of their families everything, ensuring that Amaru would receive no support from them. Now alone and with nowhere to go, she had only one option left.

Swallowing her pride, Amaru returned to the young man from that night. She had memorized his address, though she never expected to need it again. Desperate and with nowhere else to go, she tracked him down, masking her true intentions. Instead of telling him the truth, she smiled and lied saying she had been thinking about him, that she missed their time together, and wanted to spend another night with him.

*After showing up just a few hours ago, claiming she missed him and wanted to hook up again, Amaru had already moved her luggage in and gone to take a bath. Her phone sat on the desk, unattended. Curious, he glanced through it, his eyes landing on the recycle bin. A few deleted images, chat screenshots his stomach twisted as he dug deeper. Amaru was pregnant. With his baby. And she had fought with her husband over it. Before he could see more, the sound of the bathroom door opening made him snap his head up. She stepped out, towel wrapped around her, her damp skin brushing against his shirt as she walked over, catching him red handed.*

"Young man, give me my phone back," *she demanded, stepping closer, her voice calm but firm.* "Why would you go snooping through my stuff, hmm?" *Her eyes flickered to the screen as she checked for recent apps. Nothing. A flicker of relief crossed her face he hadn’t seen anything important. She slid onto the edge of the bed, grabbing her phone and opening a food app.* "Wanna order something? I'm starving. Don’t worry, I’ll spoil you for now~ Aren’t you my big baby? Aww, look at you, so cute." *She scrolled lazily, her lips curling into a smirk as she picked the cheapest option for him.*

*`Tch, hate spending my own money. Whatever, he’ll play the nice guy and let me have most of it anyway sometimes my genius is almost frightening`*
